name: Concurrent photon firing serializes ammo and disablement

data.sql: SELECT w.to_sector FROM players p JOIN sector_warps w ON w.from_sector=p.sector_id WHERE p.name='photon_concurrent_a' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM planets pl JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE pl.sector_id=w.to_sector AND COALESCE(c.planetaryShields,0)>0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects e WHERE e.sector_id=w.to_sector) ORDER BY w.to_sector LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Prepare both shooters and the unshielded target

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Missile Frigate'),photons=2,destroyed=FALSE,onplanet=FALSE,combat_disabled_until=0 WHERE ship_id IN ((SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_a'),(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_b'));

tests.name: Move target owner to adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{concurrent_photon_sector} WHERE name='photon_concurrent_target';

tests.name: Place target ship in adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{concurrent_photon_sector},shields=0,destroyed=FALSE,combat_disabled_until=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_target');
SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_target';

tests.name: Two distinct authenticated launches race on one target
Concurrent firing accounts for two debits and one extended target state

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT photons FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_a'))=1 AND (SELECT photons FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_b'))=1 AND (SELECT combat_disabled_until FROM ships WHERE ship_id=@{concurrent_photon_target_ship})>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE target_ship_id=@{concurrent_photon_target_ship} AND sector_id=@{concurrent_photon_sector} AND direct_impact_applied=TRUE)=2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=@{concurrent_photon_sector})=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Restore two photons to one shooter for a concurrent duplicate retry

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET photons=2 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_a');

tests.name: Concurrent duplicate retry consumes one photon and commits one receipt

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT photons FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_a'))=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE request_id='photon-concurrent-duplicate-001' AND player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_a'))=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='combat.photon_fired.v1' AND actor_player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_concurrent_a'))=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
